overview_description.description:
Zuddl is a conference management company that provides online conferencing services. The company's virtual event platform allows for the creation, management, and hosting of high-impact events. 

Zuddl was founded in 2020 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Zuddl is a conference management company that provides online conferencing services.

product.name: Unified Event Management Software
product.description: A software platform that manages all types of B2B events including virtual, in-person, and hybrid formats, providing tools for event creation, branding, registration, and attendee engagement.

product.name: Registration & Ticketing System
product.description: A flexible system for event registration and ticketing that supports branded, personalized, and scalable attendee sign-up experiences.

product.name: Speaker & Exhibitor Portal
product.description: A portal that facilitates coordination and communication with event speakers and exhibitors, reducing administrative overhead.

product.name: Attendee App
product.description: A customizable mobile application for event attendees that enhances navigation, engagement, and personalized experiences during events.

product.name: Onsite Solutions
product.description: Tools and services to manage onsite event experiences including check-in, badge printing, and attendee interaction facilitation.

product.name: Virtual and Hybrid Event Platform
product.description: A platform to create and manage virtual and hybrid events with tools for digital engagement and content delivery.
